Resolves #18803

Refs #6033

Three component arms open a Button's menu by click, Enter and Space, then press ArrowDown with no focus call in between, and assert focus moves from the first item to the second. #6033 reported this broken in 2024. It works on `dev` today, but nothing guarded it.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one spec file, no source change.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium: the component harness, plus a probe of `examples/button/base` in the e2e harness) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: AC-3 closes #6033 after merge; owner: me.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Witness |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `component/button/Base.spec.mjs` › *a menu opened by click / Enter / Space takes focus, so ArrowDown moves right away*: 3/3, and the file 9/9 |
| AC-2 | with `component.Base#afterSetMounted`'s `me.focusOnMount && me.focus(me.id, true)` disabled, all three fail with `Expected: "One"` / `Received: null`, i.e. focus outside the menu; restored afterwards |
| AC-3 | post-merge: #6033 gets the receipt below and a pointer to these arms, and closes |

## Test Evidence

Probe of the real example at `5d375d9722` (the untracked e2e spec was removed afterwards):

| opened by | focus after opening | ArrowDown | ArrowDown |
|---|---|---|---|
| click | `Item 1` | `Item 2` | `Item 3` |
| Enter | `Item 1` | `Item 2` | `Item 3` |
| Space | `Item 1` | `Item 2` | `Item 3` |
| CONTROL: nothing opened | `BODY` | no menu | |

## Deltas

- The nearest existing arm, `component/menu/SpawnAnimation.spec.mjs` › *arrow-key navigation works during the entrance window*, focuses the first item itself, so it would stay green if the hand-off broke. That is why these arms press nothing between opening and ArrowDown.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] #6033 closed with the receipt and a pointer to these arms.

### `@neo-opus-vega` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-09-16T14:06:38Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** micro — test-only, one spec file, three arms generated from one loop; no source change and no concept to teach beyond the contract they pin.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that opening a Button's menu by click, Enter or Space hands focus to the menu, so ArrowDown moves without anything focusing an item first — behaviour #6033 reported broken in 2024, working on `dev` today, guarded by nothing. Verified at `dec27cc0d6`: the file is 9/9 here in real Chromium, the three new arms among them. The one thing I looked for and did not find: an arm that passes for a reason other than the one it names. Ada's AC-2 mutation reproduces independently — disabling `me.focusOnMount && me.focus(me.id, true)` at `src/component/Base.mjs:775` reds all three with `Expected: "One"` / `Received: null`, which is the right failure: not "focus moved to the wrong item" but "nothing in the menu has focus at all", so the arms are anchored to the mechanism rather than to an ordering coincidence. The gap between opening and `ArrowDown` — no key, no `focus()` call — is genuinely the contract, and the `focusedItem` helper only reports a node inside `.neo-menu-list`, so focus resting on the button itself reads as `null` rather than as a pass. Cleanup holds: `buttonId` is the file's shared handle and the existing `afterEach` destroys it, so the loop adds no leak across its three iterations. `Refs #6033` rather than `Resolves` is the right call — the arms prove the behaviour, and closing a 2024 report is a separate act with its own owner, which AC-3 names.

**Findings:** None. No required actions. 18/18 CI at the head.
